en: Hand‑tinted panoramic view over a river city. In the foreground are leafy trees and several villas with light walls, metal roofs, and some bright red roofs. A tall pointed tower with decorative brickwork and a steep metal spire rises at the left. Across the broad river there is a long multi‑span bridge and, slightly downstream, an older and narrower bridge. On the opposite bank stand low wooden and masonry houses among many trees, with gentle hills in the far background. The coloring and style suggest an early 20th‑century printed postcard.
